text:
The meeting room at Marrowgate was quiet in the way of places where decisions are expected rather than argued over. On 14 March 2024, at the board's annual general meeting, Henrik Dalloway was confirmed as chair of the Marrowgate Water Board.

Priya Vennhalt, Board Secretary, read out the confirmed appointment and recorded the vote: seven of the nine members in favour. The result is set down in the meeting minutes (Ref. MWB-AGM-2024-03), published on the board's public records page.

The board has long been the kind of institution residents notice mainly when something goes wrong at the tap. Its work of pipes, reservoirs and budgets rarely makes headlines, and its chairmanship has tended to carry more duty than glamour. Dalloway now takes up that quiet responsibility, with the clear backing of most of his colleagues.
